title: Business Central 2026 release wave 1 (BC28): Copy contacts from BC to Microsoft 365 (Outlook & Teams)
summary: Business Central 2026 wave 1 introduces improved contact synchronization that lets users copy contacts from BC to Microsoft 365 Outlook and Teams with a new Synchronize with Outlook action, including enhanced security for Outlook add-ins and deprecation of Exchange Synch setup pages.
key_points: New Synchronize with Outlook action on the Contacts list enables copying contacts to Outlook and Teams with filtering and direction control options
Enhanced security requires extra one-time setup when installing Outlook add-ins; administrators can still use centralized deployment
Force full sync option available to overcome synchronization issues by synchronizing contacts regardless of last modification date
Users must upgrade to BC version 28.0 or later by October 1, 2026, as Exchange Web Services discontinuation will break these features in earlier versions

quotes.text: You can easily author mails or schedule meetings with business contacts from Outlook and Teams.
quotes.why_it_matters: Demonstrates the workflow benefit of contact synchronization for users working in email and collaboration tools
